discovery_signals.business_problem: Contract approvals are slow because sales teams cannot find the latest template or route exceptions to the right legal owner.
discovery_signals.current_state: Teams use email, shared drives, and Slack handoffs with limited visibility into approval status.
discovery_signals.desired_outcome: Automate routing, expose approval status, and reduce manual follow-up before quarter close.

discovery_signals.business_problem: Invoice packets arrive with inconsistent metadata and require manual duplicate checks.
discovery_signals.current_state: AP analysts copy document details into spreadsheets and chase missing vendor context.
discovery_signals.desired_outcome: Classify invoices, enrich metadata, and create a governed workflow for validation.

discovery_signals.business_problem: Business leaders want AI search and summaries but need confidence that sensitive content remains governed.
discovery_signals.current_state: Content permissions and lifecycle stages are hard to explain during stakeholder reviews.
discovery_signals.desired_outcome: Demonstrate AI-assisted search, summaries, and workflow recommendations with visible governance controls.
